summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting progress on its common stock repurchase program conducted under Japanese Companies Act provisions, equivalent to an issuer tender offer. The filing covers 2,085,100 shares repurchased for ¥14,800,736,200 (approx. $135M) from May 18-31, 2026, via a trust method market purchase. This is part of a board-authorized buyback of up to 25,000,000 shares (1% of outstanding) for up to ¥100 billion through August 31, 2026. No premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The repurchase is a routine capital return to shareholders. What to watch: progress toward completion of the maximum authorization and potential EPS accretion.
